Hi Karthik / Tessa,

Quick handoff note for Hearthly Health (signed SOW, Redwood Dedicated + Private control plane):
- Contract value: $420k ARR (12-month reserved capacity) — SOW signed 2027-10-01.
- Target internal kickoff / S2CS warm pass: week of Oct 18 (customer requested early Nov pilot but prefers earlier).
- Key constraints: PHI data flow, VPC peering required, customer-side SAML with Okta, SOC 2 evidence request active.
- Must-haves before kickoff: network diagram + peering window, customer technical POC, approved service account for provisioning, and signed NDA addendum (attached SOW has the addendum).

Attachments I’m dropping in this thread: signed SOW, onboarding MOP v2, network requirements spreadsheet.

Asks: could CS own the stewardship and confirm owner + kickoff date by EOD Monday? Also call out any immediate blockers (e.g., legal/INF/TI approvals).

Customer POC is Amelia Ross (Director of Platform, amelia.ross@hearthly.com). I’ve copied the high-level timeline in the body below for context.

High-level timeline:
- Oct 11–15: internal CS prep & obtain customer PO/technical access
- Oct 18–22: technical kickoff & basic connectivity validation
- Nov 1–7: pilot (limited traffic)

Thanks — I can jump on a quick sync if useful.

Priyom

Thanks for the context, Priyom — good note. I’m proposing Monica Patel as the implementation lead here based on capacity and prior Private deployment experience. Monica, would you be able to take ownership of the Stewardship transfer for Hearthly?

Initial risk/unknowns I see:
- SAML/Okta integration timing and whether Hearthly requires Just-In-Time provisioning (this will affect our IdP setup).
- SIEM/Log delivery expectations (they asked for 30-day raw audit export + SIEM webhook).
- Any HSM/KMS integration on-prem — need clarity on key custody.

If Monica takes lead, suggested immediate next steps:
1) Confirm CS owner and proposed kickoff window (I’d push for Oct 14–15 internal prep if possible).
2) Set 60-min kickoff with customer + tech POC, invite engineering (Infra & Security).
3) Validate which infra team at Hearthly will own firewall/window for peering.

Monica — if you accept, feel free to reassign or bring in additional teammates. I’ll loop in Solutions Eng if we need an architecture overview in the kickoff.

—Karthik
VP, Customer Success Ops | Redwood Inference

I can take the implementation lead for Hearthly. Thanks for the context — quick questions before I book the kickoff: 

1) Who is the technical POC on the customer side? (Priyom mentioned Amelia — is she handling infra or should we expect a separate platform engineer?)
2) Do we have network CIDR ranges and preferred peering windows from their infra team (I see network_requirements.xlsx attached but want confirmation it’s final)?
3) Any compliance artifacts already shared in the SOC2 folder, or should I request a baseline (syslog retention, encryption profiles)?

Proposed kickoff agenda (60 min):
- Introductions & success criteria (5)
- Architecture walkthrough & network/peering runbook (20)
- Auth & access: SAML flow, service accounts, and role mapping (15)
- Operational expectations: logs, monitoring, and runbook escalations (10)
- Next steps & owners (10)

I’m available for the internal prep on Oct 14 AM PT. I’ll send a Calendly link (copied in related_links) and a short pre-kickoff checklist for the customer to complete before the call.

Also flagging an internal ask: if Legal needs to sign the NDA addendum, loop Emily in Legal (I’ll route the doc). I’ll raise a ticket with Infra to reserve a provisioning window once we have the peering CIDRs.

—Monica
